title: Incomprehensible Artifact
flavorText: This tangle of cogs, springs, and wire was clearly made with some purpose in mind. Whatever that purpose could be, is anyone's guess.
name: Incomprehensible Artifact

title: Betnikh Twice-Spiked Ale
abilityDescription:
Increase Magicka Recovery by |cffffff493|r and Health Recovery by |cffffff539|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours. This drink is very gassy.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
flavorText: A seasonal drink enjoyed during the New Life Festival. This Orc ale is exceptionally foamy, which helps create "gastric affirmation."
name: Betnikh Twice-Spiked Ale

title: Jagga-Drenched "Mud Ball"
abilityDescription:
Increase Max Magicka and Max Stamina by |cffffff4936|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
flavorText: A seasonal dessert enjoyed during the New Life Festival. This Wood Elf treat is made with bone flour and senche-passed coffee beans. It is quite sticky.
name: Jagga-Drenched "Mud Ball"

title: Old Aldmeri Orphan Gruel
abilityDescription:
Increase Max Magicka by |cffffff5600|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
flavorText: A porridge traditionally served during the New Life Festival. As porridge goes, this High Elf meal is surprisingly tasty.
name: Old Aldmeri Orphan Gruel

title: Rajhin's Sugar Claws
abilityDescription:
Increase Max Stamina by |cffffff5600|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
These effects are scaled based on your level.

name: Rajhin's Sugar Claws

title: Alcaire Festival Sword-Pie
abilityDescription:
Increase Max Health by |cffffff6160|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
flavorText: A hearty meat pie enjoyed during the New Life Festival. This Breton meal is served with a miniature bone sword cooked inside. Recovering the sword is said to grant the luck of Magnus—and an occasional cracked tooth.
name: Alcaire Festival Sword-Pie

Increase Stamina Recovery by |cffffff560|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.

name: Snow Bear Glow-Wine

title: Sailor's Warning Festival Grog
flavorText: This potent drink is one of the few banned by all fleets in Tamriel. Though a spilled mug doesn't actually strip tar from a ship's deck, it is absolutely capable of removing rational thought from those who imbibe it.
name: Sailor's Warning Festival Grog

title: High Hrothgar Festival Mints
flavorText: These breath mints are supposedly concocted at a remote mountain peak. Chewing a handful produces a glacial sensation and an exceptionally frosty breath.
name: High Hrothgar Festival Mints

setBonuses.description: (5 items) When you take damage, you summon a cloud of leeching poison under the assailant. The cloud deals 559 Poison damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff5|r seconds and heals you for 106% of the damage caused. This effect can occur once every |cffffff5|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

traitDescription: Increases this item's Armor value by 12%.

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Health by |cffffff19|r.

name: Elegant Shield

setBonuses.description: (2 items) Adds 1 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you use a Light Attack you reduce the Health, Magicka, or Stamina cost of your next active ability cast within |cffffff2|r seconds by 10%.  

When you use a fully-charged Heavy Attack you gain Empower for |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%.

Each of these effects can occur once every second.

traitDescription: Increases Critical Resistance by 46 and this item takes |cffffff50|r% less durability damage.

name: Aetheric Cipher
